dup-key-shadowed-float.btxbundle.note: RejectFloats() must reject the shadowed 1.5. Today DecodeBtxBundle ACCEPTS this because getKeys() yields 'n' twice but v['n'] resolves to the first value.

dup-key-shadowed-secret.btxbundle.note: ScanPublic()/PublicExportObjectAllowed() must reject the shadowed api_key. Today the second 'a' subtree is never visited, so the secret survives export/import.

dup-key-toplevel-secret.btxbundle.note: Control for the two above: a duplicated FORBIDDEN key name is still caught, because the key-name test runs per getKeys() entry.

int-overflow-core-version.btx.note: btx-open must report an error. Today (*core)['version'].getInt<int>() throws std::runtime_error after the isNum() guard and the process aborts (SIGABRT).

int-overflow-auto-spend.btx.note: EncodeMagnetAnalog() must return false ('spend mandate forbidden'). Today getInt<int64_t>() throws instead of refusing, so the no-auto-spend guard raises rather than rejecting.

non-btx-uri.btx.note: EncodeMagnetAnalog() must refuse a non-btx:// uri. Today it accepts any non-empty string; ValidateResources() enforces the btx:// prefix but the magnet-analog path does not.

dn-in-uri.btx.note: EncodeMagnetAnalog()/ParseMagnetAnalog() must refuse dn= in the uri query. Enforced today by UriQueryHasDn().

nonzero-auto-spend.btx.note: EncodeMagnetAnalog() must refuse a nonzero spend mandate. Enforced today.

unknown-schema-version.btx.note: ParseMagnetAnalog() must refuse an unknown schema_version. Today it only checks that the field exists and silently rewrites it to 2.

control-chars-in-copy-text.btx.note: copy_text must pass a SafeText()-style control/bidi filter before it is echoed to a terminal or UI. Today it is copied verbatim and uncapped.

presigned-url.btx.note: LintPackagePortable() rejects this. EncodeMagnetAnalog() does not call it, so the export path alone does not stop an embedded presigned capability.

stale-percent-funded-no-state.json.note: Cached observation with a funding number but no 'state' field. Used as cached_observation with an empty local_chain (offline): EvaluatePackageRewardPreview() reports cached_stale=false today.

cross-unit-amount-match.json.note: AmountMismatch() compares percent_funded against confirmed_funded_atoms, so 50 percent and 50 atoms compare equal and the cache is reported fresh.

frame-declared-len-max.btxbundle.note: declared payload_len = 2^64-1. Rejected today, but btx-open surfaces the BUNDLE_WRITE message 'flags/size/trailing' instead of PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE.

frame-truncated.bin.note: Header shorter than 68 bytes. Rejected today.

codec_divergence.note: Same logical package, two byte strings, both accepted under the one BTXPKG\x00\x01 magic. package_core_id is identical; the frame sha384 is not. Identify packages by package_core_id, never by file hash.
